startUrls.title: Page URLs
startUrls.description: One or more web page URLs to convert to Markdown. Each successfully scraped page is charged once.

url.title: Single page URL (optional)
url.description: Shortcut for scraping just one page. You can use this instead of, or in addition to, the list above.

renderJs.title: Render JavaScript
renderJs.description: Load each page in a real browser so content built by JavaScript is captured. Slower, but works on modern app-style sites.

renderWaitMs.title: Extra wait after load (ms)
renderWaitMs.description: When 'Render JavaScript' is on, wait this many extra milliseconds after the page loads so late content can appear.

includeLinks.title: Keep hyperlinks
includeLinks.description: If on, hyperlinks are kept in the Markdown. Turn off for cleaner plain prose.
